paragraphs: AbbVie Inc., also known as AbbVie, is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in North Chicago, Illinois. AbbVie produces drugs to treat a wide range of medical issues.

The company is ranked sixth on the list of largest biomedical companies by revenue. It is ranked 77th on the Fortune 500 and 108th on the Forbes Global 2000. The name "AbbVie" is derived from a combination of "Abbott", the name of its former parent company, with "vie", intended as a reference to a Latin root meaning 'life'.
description.title: AbbVie

people.name: Robert A. Michael
people.title: Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Michael became Chairman and Chief Executive Officer in July 2025 after serving as Chief Executive Officer starting in 2024. He previously held several AbbVie leadership positions, including President and Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Michael is AbbVie's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, a position he has held since July 2025.

people.name: Scott T. Reents
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Reents previously served as Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer from June to November 2022 and as Vice President, Tax and Treasury from 2019 to June 2022. He joined Abbott in 2008 and was first appointed an AbbVie corporate officer in June 2022.
people.quote: Mr. Reents is AbbVie's Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer.

people.name: Demetris D. Crum
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Crum joined AbbVie in 2017 and previously served as Vice President, Total Rewards from August 2022 to June 2025. Before AbbVie, he held human resources leadership roles at The Kraft Heinz Company and PepsiCo.
people.quote: Mr. Crum is AbbVie's Executive Vice President, Chief Human Resources Officer.

people.name: Nicholas J. Donoghoe, M.D.
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Business and Strategy Officer
people.bio: Donoghoe joined AbbVie in January 2019 and previously served as Senior Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, R&D from 2022 to 2023. Before joining AbbVie, he was a Partner at McKinsey & Company and a leader of its Pharma and Biotechnology practice.
people.quote: Nicholas Donoghoe, M.D., Executive Vice President, Chief Business and Strategy Officer, was appointed as an executive officer of AbbVie during 2023.

people.name: Azita Saleki-Gerhardt, Ph.D.
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operations Officer
people.bio: Saleki-Gerhardt previously served as Executive Vice President, Operations from 2018 to July 2023 and as Senior Vice President, Operations from 2013 to 2018. She joined Abbott in 1993 and serves on the board of Entegris Inc.
people.quote: Dr. Saleki-Gerhardt is AbbVie's Executive Vice President, Chief Operations Officer.

people.name: Perry C. Siatis
people.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary
people.bio: Siatis previously served as Senior Vice President, Deputy General Counsel from September 2021 until October 2022 and held various AbbVie legal and compliance roles from 2013 to 2021. He joined Abbott in 2005 and was first appointed an AbbVie corporate officer in October 2022.
people.quote: Mr. Siatis is AbbVie's Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary.

people.name: Jeffrey R. Stewart
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Commercial Officer
people.bio: Stewart previously served as Senior Vice President, U.S. Commercial Operations from 2018 to 2020 and as President, U.S. Commercial Operations from 2013 to 2018. He joined Abbott in 1992 and was first appointed an AbbVie corporate officer in December 2018.
people.quote: Mr. Stewart is AbbVie's Executive Vice President, Chief Commercial Officer.

people.name: Roopal Thakkar, M.D.
people.title: Executive Vice President, Research & Development and Chief Scientific Officer
people.bio: Thakkar previously served as Senior Vice President of Development and Regulatory Affairs and Chief Medical Officer from 2022 until 2023, following leadership roles in global regulatory affairs. He joined Abbott in 2003 and was first appointed an AbbVie corporate officer in December 2023.
people.quote: Dr. Thakkar serves as AbbVie's Executive Vice President, Research & Development and Chief Scientific Officer.

people.name: David R. Purdue
people.title: Senior Vice President, Controller
people.bio: Purdue previously served as Vice President, Controller, Commercial Operations from 2023 to 2025 and as Vice President, Corporate Treasurer from 2022 to 2023. He joined Abbott in 2003 and was first appointed an AbbVie corporate officer in March 2025.
people.quote: Mr. Purdue is AbbVie's Senior Vice President, Controller.

people.name: William H.L. Burnside
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Burnside is a retired Senior Vice President and director at The Boston Consulting Group. He became managing partner of BCG's Los Angeles office in 1987 and served as an advisor from 2011 to 2023.
people.quote: Mr. Burnside is a retired Senior Vice President and director at The Boston Consulting Group (BCG).

people.name: Thomas C. Freyman
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Freyman served as Executive Vice President, Finance and Administration at Abbott Laboratories from 2015 until his retirement in 2017, following earlier chief financial officer roles. He served as an Allergan director from 2018 to 2020, when AbbVie acquired Allergan plc.
people.quote: Mr. Freyman served as a director at Allergan from 2018 to 2020, when AbbVie acquired Allergan plc.

people.name: Brett J. Hart
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Hart is President of United Airlines Holdings, Inc. and United Airlines, Inc. He previously held executive, administrative and general counsel roles at United and served as acting Chief Executive Officer from October 2015 to March 2016.
people.quote: Mr. Hart is the President of United Airlines Holdings, Inc. (UAL) and United Airlines, Inc.

people.name: Edward J. Rapp
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mr. Rapp served as Caterpillar's Group President for resource industries from 2014 until his retirement in mid-2016, following roles including Chief Financial Officer from 2010 to 2013. He also serves as a director of Xos, Inc.
people.quote: Mr. Rapp served as the Caterpillar Inc. Group President for resource industries from 2014 until his retirement in mid-2016.

people.name: Rebecca B. Roberts
people.title: Director
people.bio: Ms. Roberts served as President of Chevron Pipe Line Company from 2006 until her retirement in 2011 and previously led Chevron Global Power Generation from 2003 to 2006. She began her career as a chemist and research scientist.
people.quote: Ms. Roberts served as President of Chevron Pipe Line Company from 2006 until her retirement in 2011.
